name: Cash
description: Default cash and operating bank account.

name: Escrow - Tax and Insurance
description: Escrow reserve balance held by mortgage servicer for property taxes and hazard insurance.

name: Escrow - Mortgage Principal
description: Principal amortization holding account for loan payments.

name: Escrow - Mortgage P&I
description: Combined principal and interest clearing account for recurring unamortized mortgage disbursements.

name: Accounts Receivable
description: Uncollected rent and charges due from tenants.

name: Capital Improvements
description: Property improvements and capitalized upgrades subject to depreciation.

name: Reserve Fund
description: Operating and replacement reserve funds held in liquid savings/money market accounts.

name: Supplies Inventory
description: Maintenance supplies, fixtures, and materials inventory on hand.

name: Land
description: Non-depreciable real property land basis.

name: Buildings
description: Depreciable real property building and structure basis.

name: Accumulated Depreciation - Buildings
description: Contra-asset tracking cumulative MACRS/straight-line building depreciation.

name: Equipment
description: Appliances, HVAC units, maintenance equipment, and personal property.

name: Accumulated Depreciation - Equipment
description: Contra-asset tracking cumulative depreciation on equipment and appliances.

name: Notes Receivable
description: Promissory notes, mortgages, or seller financing due to the business.

name: Notes Payable
description: Long-term mortgages and secured loans payable against properties.

name: Accounts Payable
description: Amounts owed to contractors, vendors, and suppliers for goods and services.

name: Tenant Deposits
description: Security and pet deposits held on behalf of tenants.

name: Pre-Paid Rent
description: Advance rental payments and last month's rent collected prior to due date.

name: Business Owner Capital
description: Owner equity contributions and initial capital investments.

name: Business Owner Drawing
description: Owner withdrawals and partnership distributions.

name: Rental Income
description: Gross rental income from residential and commercial property leases.

name: Late Fees
description: Late charges and non-sufficient funds (NSF) penalty fees.

name: Other Income
description: Application fees, parking fees, laundry service, and miscellaneous revenue.

name: Mortgage Interest Income
description: Interest earned on seller-financed notes or bank balances.

name: Escrow Mortgage Income
description: Escrow servicing collections and interest on escrow reserves.

name: Advertising Expense
description: Marketing, signage, online syndication, and leasing advertisements.

name: Auto and Travel Expense
description: Mileage, vehicle maintenance, and travel incurred for property management.

name: Cleaning / Janitorial
description: Unit turnover turnover cleaning, carpet shampooing, and common area janitorial.

name: Commissions and Fees
description: Real estate leasing commissions, tenant screening fees, and merchant processing.

name: Insurance Expense
description: Hazard, liability, flood, and umbrella insurance policy premiums.

name: Interest Expense
description: Mortgage loan interest and line-of-credit financing charges.

name: Lawn Maintenance
description: Grounds keeping, tree trimming, and routine lawn mowing services.

name: Management Fees
description: Professional property management service fees.

name: Pest Control
description: Routine extermination and termite protection treatments.

name: Professional Fees
description: Legal counsel, CPA accounting, tax preparation, and architectural fees.

name: Property Taxes
description: County ad valorem property taxes and non-ad valorem assessments.

name: Repairs & Maintenance
description: Routine plumbing, electrical, roofing, and structural repairs.

name: Weather Events
description: Hurricane preparation, storm cleanup, and snow removal emergency expenditures.

name: Supplies Expense
description: Non-capitalized operating supplies, locks, smoke detectors, and air filters.

name: Utilities: Electric
description: Electric power utility bills for vacant units and common areas.

name: Utilities: Gas
description: Natural gas and propane utilities.

name: Utilities: Irrigation
description: Sprinkler and irrigation water utility disbursements.

name: Utilities: Telephone
description: Office phone, security dialers, and internet connectivity services.

name: Utilities: Water/Sewer/Trash
description: Municipal water, sanitary sewer, and dumpster trash collection services.
